Packaging a tool with flakes

None of the code blocks below say what language they are in, as is common with static site generators that drop the class.

{ pkgs, lib, ... }:
{
  environment.systemPackages = with pkgs; [ git vim ];
  services.openssh.enable = true;
  programs.fish.enable = lib.mkDefault true;
}

Build it with:

nix build .#default --no-link

The package itself:

{
  lib,
  buildGoModule,
}:
buildGoModule {
  pname = "izrss";
  version = "0.4.0";
  src = ./.;
  vendorHash = lib.fakeHash;
  ldflags = [ "-s" "-w" ];
  meta.mainProgram = "izrss";
}

A shell script that wraps it:

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
for f in "$@"; do
  echo "building $f"
done

And the secrets file, which is YAML:

keys:
  - &isabel age1qyqszqgpqyqszqgpqyqszqgpqyqszqgpqyqszqgpqyqszqgpqyqs
creation_rules:
  - path_regex: secrets/[^/]+\.yaml$

Plain output is left alone:

hello world, this is just some output
from a command that ran
